description: Whether an NTFS volume is marked dirty: the flag VOLUME_IS_DIRTY (0x0001) of the $VOLUME_INFORMATION attribute of $Volume, the fourth record of the MFT, read from the boot sector's geometry, the record's update sequence applied.

cases.note: marked dirty, as an unclean drop leaves it
other flags, not dirty: resize the log file, mounted on NT4
4096-byte clusters and records of one cluster
sectors per cluster as a power of two: 0xF7 is 2^9
a torn record: a block's end is not the update number
an update sequence of the wrong length
a sector size that is no power of two
